subject: Alignment: MAP, legal sequencing & close timeline
messages:
From: Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Rishi —

Thanks for the runthrough this morning. Procurement asked that we put a clear MAP into the contract negotiation so internal stakeholder signoffs line up with the PO and vendor onboarding windows. I attached our internal MAP (Avery_MAP_v3.docx) — the dates are optimistic but reflect the procurement committee's preference to close by the second week of September.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood confirm whether the MSA must be fully executed before DPA redlines are accepted by legal (we have parallel tracks internally, so clarity helps).
- Do you have a short critical-path timeline that maps MSA/DPA/order form sequencing to procurement milestones (PO submission, vendor checks, invoice schedule)?

We're happy to be flexible but need a version we can show to procurement tomorrow.

—Jamie
Senior Product Manager
Avery Labs

Attachment: Avery_MAP_v3.docx (Microsoft Word)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Jamie — thanks for the MAP and the context. Attached is a near-term draft (redwood_orderform_draft.pdf) and a one-page critical path I sketched. High level summary:

- We recommend the following order for minimal gating risk: Order Form sign-off (pricing & SOW) -> PO issuance -> MSA signature -> DPA finalization (minor redlines only) -> Tech onboarding window.
- If your procurement insists on the MSA first, we can accommodate, but that typically moves DPA iterations into post-signature housekeeping rather than gating onboarding.
- Target close: we can meet your Sept 10 goal if we get PO by Sept 3 and receive any material legal redlines (not just comments) by Aug 28.

Action items I propose:
1) Avery procurement to confirm PO submission target (can you confirm Sept 3?).
2) If PO slips, we fallback to a two-week staggered onboarding where SOW work starts only after MSA is locked.
3) Laura — can you call out any non-negotiable clauses that must be in the MSA before we sign?

I'll mark up the MAP to show the critical path and return an updated file by EOD Wed.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_orderform_draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T15:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Rishi / Jamie —

Quick legal note on sequencing: we generally treat the MSA as the foundational document. Key items that typically must be agreed prior to signature: liability cap, data processing scope, and termination for convenience provisions. DPA can be finalized as an exhibit if both sides agree, but any material DPA terms that expand data access or retention beyond the MSA need to be reflected in the MSA or noted as pending with specific acceptance criteria.

If Avery can confirm the data categories and residency expectations, we can fast-track the DPA as an exhibit. I recommend the following:
- Mark the DPA as "DPA - pending exhibit" in the MSA and include a 10-business-day finalization window post-MSA signature.
- Include a short schedule in the Order Form listing the PO date, target onboarding, and who signs each doc.

I'll prepare redline guidance for the MSA and call out any clauses that could block procurement. Sending that to you by tomorrow morning.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Labs Procurement <procurement@averylabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Rishi / Team —

Confirming procurement's constraints:
- We require an executed PO to release funds for pilot onboarding.
- We prefer vendor onboarding to occur within 5 business days of PO, assuming no outstanding legal holds.
- Pricing needs to be locked on the Order Form — procurement will not accept open pricing placeholders.

We can aim for PO issuance by Sept 3 only if the MSA and Order Form are essentially final (minor DPA redlines acceptable). If MSA contains broad liability carve-outs or extended indemnities, procurement will push to the next cycle.

Also attaching our PO template (Avery_PO_template.xlsx) for your finance team to validate.

—Procurement (Avery Labs)
Attachment: Avery_PO_template.xlsx (Excel)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Looping in a quick engineering/onboarding note. If we proceed with the two-track approach (Order Form / PO + MSA signed, DPA finalized post-signature) we need the following to be explicit in the MAP:
- Types of data used in evaluation (sample PII/no-PII) and whether synthetic data can be used for initial tests.
- Expected SLA for streaming inference during the pilot (p50/p95 latency targets) and a minimum token quota to validate throughput.
- Any region-specific hosting constraints — if Avery requires EU-only data residency we need an early notice (we can provide Private deployment but lead time is ~3 weeks).

If Jamie confirms the data is non-PII and the evaluation can start with synthetic inputs, we can run a short tech validation within 72 hours of PO. Otherwise, engineering needs 10 business days for compliance setup.

—Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <j.torres@averylabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: MAP & sequencing for pilot contract

Jamie — thanks everyone for the quick turn. I've updated the MAP to reflect the agreed critical path and attached an "Activation Checklist" so procurement and legal have a single-page view. Key commitments:

- PO target: Sept 3 (Avery to confirm) — triggers 5 business day onboarding window.
- If PO arrives on Sept 3, Redwood will schedule tech validation (synthetic data) to start Sept 7 with an expected validation complete by Sept 10.
- MSA: sign-off required on liability cap and data scope; Laura to circulate redline guidance by EOD Sept 4.
- DPA: allowed as an exhibit but must be finalized within 10 business days of MSA signature.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Avery procurement: confirm PO issuance date (owner: procurement@averylabs.com) — due by EOD Sept 3.
- Laura: circulate MSA redline guidance — due Sept 4.
- Karthik: prepare tech validation checklist and reserve sandbox capacity — due Sept 5.
- Rishi/Marissa: send final Order Form and Activation Checklist (attached) — done.

If procurement confirms PO tomorrow, we are green to hit the Sept 10 onboarding milestone. If PO slips, we'll fall back to the staggered start described earlier.

Thanks — I'll update the HubSpot deal and share the DocuSign envelope once MSA is ready for signature.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Activation_Checklist_Avery.pdf, updated_MAP_Avery_v4.docx, redwood_orderform_final.pdf
